instruction: Access the Settings section in Thunderbird so I can manage its configuration options.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Settings/Preferences page in Thunderbird. This can be accessed via Edit > Settings or hamburger menu > Settings. Evaluator uses check_accessibility_tree to verify the 'Settings' tab is present in the tab list. Similar difficulty to original task - straightforward navigation to a settings interface.
metadata.verification: The evaluator checks for the presence of a page-tab named 'Settings' in the Thunderbird tab list using accessibility tree selectors. This matches the expected behavior when Settings is opened.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement by checking for the presence of a Settings tab in Thunderbird
CSS selector 'application[name=Thunderbird] page-tab-list[attr|id="tabmail-tabs"]>page-tab[name="Settings"]' appropriately targets the Settings tab element
check_accessibility_tree metric properly implements presence verification logic (returns 0.0 if not found, 1.0 if found)
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (open Settings), evaluator checks that requirement
No postconfig needed: accessibility tree reflects current state and Settings tab remains open after task completion
No issues with state accessibility, expected values, or logical correctness
